1224 void MmwDemo_CfgUpdate(void *srcPtr, uint32_t offset, uint32_t size, int8_t subFrameNum)
1225 {
1226  /* if subFrameNum undefined, broadcast to all sub-frames */
1227  if(subFrameNum == MMWDEMO_SUBFRAME_NUM_FRAME_LEVEL_CONFIG)
1228  {
1229  uint8_t indx;
1230  for(indx = 0; indx < RL_MAX_SUBFRAMES; indx++)
1231  {
1232  memcpy((void *)((uint32_t) &gMmwMssMCB.subFrameCfg[indx] + offset), srcPtr, size);
1233  MmwDemo_setSubFramePendingState(&gMmwMssMCB.subFrameCfg[indx], offset);
1234  }
1235  }
1236  else
1237  {
1238  /* Apply configuration to specific subframe (or to position zero for the legacy case
1239  where there is no advanced frame config) */
1240  memcpy((void *)((uint32_t) &gMmwMssMCB.subFrameCfg[subFrameNum] + offset), srcPtr, size);
1241  MmwDemo_setSubFramePendingState(&gMmwMssMCB.subFrameCfg[subFrameNum], offset);
1242  }
1243 }

1275 static void MmwDemo_measurementResultOutput(void *compRxChanCfg)
1276 {
1277 int32_t i;
1278 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
1279  DPU_AoAProc_compRxChannelBiasCfg *result = (DPU_AoAProc_compRxChannelBiasCfg*)compRxChanCfg;
1280  CLI_write ("compRangeBiasAndRxChanPhase (Re-Im) \n");
1281  CLI_write (" %.7f ", result->rangeBias);
1282 
1283  /* Send the received DSS calibration info through CLI */
1284  for (i = 0; i < SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS*SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL; i++)
1285  {
1286  CLI_write ("%.5f ", (float)result->rxChPhaseComp[i].real/32768.);
1287  CLI_write ("%.5f ", (float)result->rxChPhaseComp[i].imag/32768.);
1288  }
1289  CLI_write ("\n");
1290 
1291 #elif defined(MMWDEMO_DDM)
1292  Measure_compRxChannelBiasCfg *result = (Measure_compRxChannelBiasCfg*)compRxChanCfg;
1293  CLI_write ("compRxChanPhase (Im-Re) \n");
1294  CLI_write("range %.5f peakVal %d \n", result->targetRange, result->peakVal);
1295 
1296  /* Send the received DSS calibration info through CLI */
1297  for (i = 0; i < SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS*SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL; i++)
1298  {
1299  CLI_write ("%.5f ", (float)result->rxChPhaseComp[i].imag/16384.);
1300  CLI_write ("%.5f ", (float)result->rxChPhaseComp[i].real/16384.);
1301  }
1302  CLI_write ("\n");
1303 #endif
1304 }

1351 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
1352  cmplx16ImRe_t *azimuthStaticHeatMap;
1353 #endif
1354  DPIF_PointCloudSideInfo *objOutSideInfo;
1355  DPC_ObjectDetection_Stats *stats;
1356  UART_Transaction trans;

1358  UART_Transaction_init(&trans);
1359 
1360  /* Get subframe configuration */

1363 #ifdef MMWDEMO_DDM

1367 #endif

1371 
1372  /* Clear message header */
1373  memset((void *)&header, 0, sizeof(MmwDemo_output_message_header));
1374 
1375  /******************************************************************
1376  Send out data that is enabled, Since processing results are from DSP,
1377  address translation is needed for buffer pointers
1378  *******************************************************************/
1379  {
1380  detMatrix = (uint16_t *) AddrTranslateP_getLocalAddr((uint32_t)detMatrix);
1381 
1382  objOut = (DPIF_PointCloudCartesian *) AddrTranslateP_getLocalAddr((uint32_t)result->objOut);
1383 
1384  objOutSideInfo = (DPIF_PointCloudSideInfo *) AddrTranslateP_getLocalAddr((uint32_t)result->objOutSideInfo);
1385 
1386  stats = (DPC_ObjectDetection_Stats *) AddrTranslateP_getLocalAddr((uint32_t)result->stats);
1387 
1388 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
1389  result->radarCube.data = (void *) AddrTranslateP_getLocalAddr((uint32_t)result->radarCube.data);
1390 #endif
1391 
1392  }
1393 
1394  /* Header: */
1395 #ifdef SOC_AWR2944
1396  header.platform = 0x2944;
1397 #else
1398  header.platform = 0x2943;
1399 #endif
1400  header.magicWord[0] = 0x0102;
1401  header.magicWord[1] = 0x0304;
1402  header.magicWord[2] = 0x0506;
1403  header.magicWord[3] = 0x0708;
1404  header.numDetectedObj = result->numObjOut;
1405  header.version = MMWAVE_SDK_VERSION_BUILD |
1406  (MMWAVE_SDK_VERSION_BUGFIX << 8) |
1407  (MMWAVE_SDK_VERSION_MINOR << 16) |
1408  (MMWAVE_SDK_VERSION_MAJOR << 24);
1409 
1410  packetLen = sizeof(MmwDemo_output_message_header);
1411  if (((pGuiMonSel->detectedObjects == 1) || (pGuiMonSel->detectedObjects == 2)) &&
1412  (result->numObjOut > 0))
1413  {
1414  tl[tlvIdx].type = MMWDEMO_OUTPUT_MSG_DETECTED_POINTS;
1415  tl[tlvIdx].length = sizeof(DPIF_PointCloudCartesian) * result->numObjOut;
1416  packetLen += sizeof(MmwDemo_output_message_tl) + tl[tlvIdx].length;
1417  tlvIdx++;
1418  }
1419  /* Side info */
1420  if ((pGuiMonSel->detectedObjects == 1) && (result->numObjOut > 0))
1421  {
1422  tl[tlvIdx].type = MMWDEMO_OUTPUT_MSG_DETECTED_POINTS_SIDE_INFO;

1424  packetLen += sizeof(MmwDemo_output_message_tl) + tl[tlvIdx].length;
1425  tlvIdx++;

1427  if (pGuiMonSel->logMagRange)

1433  }
1434  if (pGuiMonSel->noiseProfile)
1435  {
1436  tl[tlvIdx].type = MMWDEMO_OUTPUT_MSG_NOISE_PROFILE;

1440  }

1455 #elif defined(MMWDEMO_DDM)

1467 
1468  MmwDemo_getTemperatureReport();

1472  tlvIdx++;
1473  }
1474 
1475  header.numTLVs = tlvIdx;
1476  /* Round up packet length to multiple of MMWDEMO_OUTPUT_MSG_SEGMENT_LEN */
1477  header.totalPacketLen = MMWDEMO_OUTPUT_MSG_SEGMENT_LEN *
1478  ((packetLen + (MMWDEMO_OUTPUT_MSG_SEGMENT_LEN-1))/MMWDEMO_OUTPUT_MSG_SEGMENT_LEN);
1479  header.timeCpuCycles = 0; //Pmu_getCount(0);
1480  header.frameNumber = stats->frameStartIntCounter;
1481  header.subFrameNumber = result->subFrameIdx;
1482 
1483  DebugP_logInfo("Platform = %d, Version = %d, NumObj = %d, numTLVs = %d", header.platform, header.version, header.numDetectedObj, header.numTLVs);
1484 
1485  CacheP_wbInv((void *)&header, sizeof(MmwDemo_output_message_header), CacheP_TYPE_ALLD);
1486  UART_Transaction_init(&trans);
1487  trans.buf = (uint8_t*)&header;
1488  trans.count = sizeof(MmwDemo_output_message_header);
1489  UART_write(uartHandle, &trans);
1490 
1491  tlvIdx = 0;
1492  /* Send detected Objects */
1493  if (((pGuiMonSel->detectedObjects == 1) || (pGuiMonSel->detectedObjects == 2)) &&
1494  (result->numObjOut > 0))
1495  {
1496  UART_Transaction_init(&trans);
1497  trans.buf = (uint8_t*)&tl[tlvIdx];

1501  /*Send array of objects */

1514  SemaphoreP_post(&objDataSemaphoreHandle);

1518  /* Send detected Objects Side Info */
1519  if ((pGuiMonSel->detectedObjects == 1) && (result->numObjOut > 0))
1520  {
1521 
1522  UART_Transaction_init(&trans);
1523  trans.buf = (uint8_t*)&tl[tlvIdx];
1524  trans.count = sizeof(MmwDemo_output_message_tl);

1534  /* Send Range profile */
1535  if (pGuiMonSel->logMagRange)
1536  {
1537  UART_Transaction_init(&trans);
1538  trans.buf = (uint8_t*)&tl[tlvIdx];

1542  for(index = 0; index < subFrameCfg->numRangeBins; index++)

1556  /* Send noise profile */

1564 
1565  for(index = 0; index < subFrameCfg->numRangeBins; index++)

1600 
1601  UART_Transaction_init(&trans);
1602  trans.buf = (uint8_t*)detMatrix;

1608  /* Send stats information */

1615 
1616  /* Address translation is done when buffer is received*/
1617  UART_Transaction_init(&trans);

1633  /* Send padding bytes */

1656 static int32_t MmwDemo_mmWaveCtrlStop (void)
1657 {
1658  int32_t errCode = 0;
1659 
1660  DebugP_logInfo("App: Issuing MMWave_stop\n");
1661 
1662  /* Stop the mmWave module: */
1663  if (MMWave_stop (gMmwMssMCB.ctrlHandle, &errCode) < 0)
1664  {
1665  MMWave_ErrorLevel errorLevel;
1666  int16_t mmWaveErrorCode;
1667  int16_t subsysErrorCode;
1668 
1669  /* Error/Warning: Unable to stop the mmWave module */
1670  MMWave_decodeError (errCode, &errorLevel, &mmWaveErrorCode, &subsysErrorCode);
1671  if (errorLevel == MMWave_ErrorLevel_ERROR)
1672  {
1673  /* Error: Display the error message: */
1674  test_print ("Error: mmWave Stop failed [Error code: %d Subsystem: %d]\n",
1675  mmWaveErrorCode, subsysErrorCode);
1676 
1677  /* Not expected */
1678  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
1679  }
1680  else
1681  {
1682  /* Warning: This is treated as a successful stop. */
1683  test_print ("mmWave Stop error ignored [Error code: %d Subsystem: %d]\n",
1684  mmWaveErrorCode, subsysErrorCode);
1685  }
1686  }
1687 
1688  return errCode;
1689 }

1780 static int32_t MmwDemo_configCQ(MmwDemo_SubFrameCfg *subFrameCfg,
1781  uint8_t numChirpsPerChirpEvent,
1782  uint8_t validProfileIdx)
1783 {
1784  MmwDemo_AnaMonitorCfg* ptrAnaMonitorCfg;
1785  ADCBuf_CQConf cqConfig;
1786  rlRxSatMonConf_t* ptrSatMonCfg;
1787  rlSigImgMonConf_t* ptrSigImgMonCfg;
1788  int32_t retVal;
1789  uint16_t cqChirpSize;
1790 
1791  /* Get analog monitor configuration */
1792  ptrAnaMonitorCfg = &gMmwMssMCB.anaMonCfg;
1793 
1794  /* Config mmwaveLink to enable Saturation monitor - CQ2 */
1795  ptrSatMonCfg = &gMmwMssMCB.cqSatMonCfg[validProfileIdx];
1796 
1797  if (ptrAnaMonitorCfg->rxSatMonEn)
1798  {
1799  if (ptrSatMonCfg->profileIndx != validProfileIdx)
1800  {
1801  test_print ("Error: Saturation monitoring (globally) enabled but not configured for profile(%d)\n",
1802  validProfileIdx);
1803  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
1804  }
1805 
1806  retVal = mmwDemo_cfgRxSaturationMonitor(ptrSatMonCfg);
1807  if(retVal != 0)
1808  {
1809  test_print ("Error: rlRfRxIfSatMonConfig returns error = %d for profile(%d)\n",
1810  retVal, ptrSatMonCfg->profileIndx);
1811  goto exit;
1812  }
1813  }
1814 
1815  /* Config mmwaveLink to enable Saturation monitor - CQ1 */
1816  ptrSigImgMonCfg = &gMmwMssMCB.cqSigImgMonCfg[validProfileIdx];
1817 
1818  if (ptrAnaMonitorCfg->sigImgMonEn)
1819  {
1820  if (ptrSigImgMonCfg->profileIndx != validProfileIdx)
1821  {
1822  test_print ("Error: Sig/Image monitoring (globally) enabled but not configured for profile(%d)\n",
1823  validProfileIdx);
1824  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
1825  }
1826 
1827  retVal = mmwDemo_cfgRxSigImgMonitor(ptrSigImgMonCfg);
1828  if(retVal != 0)
1829  {
1830  test_print ("Error: rlRfRxSigImgMonConfig returns error = %d for profile(%d)\n",
1831  retVal, ptrSigImgMonCfg->profileIndx);
1832  goto exit;
1833  }
1834  }
1835 
1836  retVal = mmwDemo_cfgAnalogMonitor(ptrAnaMonitorCfg);
1837  if (retVal != 0)
1838  {
1839  test_print ("Error: rlRfAnaMonConfig returns error = %d\n", retVal);
1840  goto exit;
1841  }
1842 
1843  if(ptrAnaMonitorCfg->rxSatMonEn || ptrAnaMonitorCfg->sigImgMonEn)
1844  {
1845  /* CQ driver config */
1846  memset((void *)&cqConfig, 0, sizeof(ADCBuf_CQConf));
1847  cqConfig.cqDataWidth = 0; /* 16bit for mmw demo */
1848  cqConfig.cq1AddrOffset = MMW_DEMO_CQ_SIGIMG_ADDR_OFFSET; /* CQ1 starts from the beginning of the buffer */
1849  cqConfig.cq2AddrOffset = MMW_DEMO_CQ_RXSAT_ADDR_OFFSET; /* Address should be 16 bytes aligned */
1850 
1851  retVal = ADCBuf_control(gMmwMssMCB.adcBufHandle, ADCBufMMWave_CMD_CONF_CQ, (void *)&cqConfig);
1852  if (retVal < 0)
1853  {
1854  test_print ("Error: MMWDemoDSS Unable to configure the CQ\n");
1855  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
1856  }
1857  }
1858 
1859  if (ptrAnaMonitorCfg->sigImgMonEn)
1860  {
1861  /* This is for 16bit format in mmw demo, signal/image band data has 2 bytes/slice
1862  For other format, please check DFP interface document
1863  */
1864  cqChirpSize = (ptrSigImgMonCfg->numSlices + 1) * sizeof(uint16_t);
1865  cqChirpSize = MATHUTILS_ROUND_UP_UNSIGNED(cqChirpSize, MMW_DEMO_CQ_DATA_ALIGNMENT);
1866  subFrameCfg->sigImgMonTotalSize = cqChirpSize * numChirpsPerChirpEvent;
1867  }
1868 
1869  if (ptrAnaMonitorCfg->rxSatMonEn)
1870  {
1871  /* This is for 16bit format in mmw demo, saturation data has one byte/slice
1872  For other format, please check DFP interface document
1873  */
1874  cqChirpSize = (ptrSatMonCfg->numSlices + 1) * sizeof(uint8_t);
1875  cqChirpSize = MATHUTILS_ROUND_UP_UNSIGNED(cqChirpSize, MMW_DEMO_CQ_DATA_ALIGNMENT);
1876  subFrameCfg->satMonTotalSize = cqChirpSize * numChirpsPerChirpEvent;
1877  }
1878 
1879 exit:
1880  return(retVal);
1881 }

1897 static uint16_t MmwDemo_convertCfarToLinear(uint16_t codedCfarVal, uint8_t numVirtualAntennas)
1898 {
1899  uint16_t linearVal;
1900  float dbVal, linVal;
1901 
1902  /* dbVal is a float value from 0-100dB. It needs to
1903  be converted to linear scale..
1904  First, recover float dbVal that was encoded in CLI. */
1905  dbVal = (float)(codedCfarVal / MMWDEMO_CFAR_THRESHOLD_ENCODING_FACTOR);
1906 
1907  /* Now convert it to linear value according to the following:
1908  linear_value = dB_value * (256 / 6) * (numVirtualAntennas / (2^ ceil(log2(numVirtualAntennas)))) .
1909  */
1910  linVal = dbVal * (256.0 / 6.0) * ((float)numVirtualAntennas / (float)(1 << mathUtils_ceilLog2(numVirtualAntennas)));
1911 
1912  linearVal = (uint16_t) linVal;
1913  return (linearVal);
1914 }
1915 #endif
1916 
1917 #ifdef MMWDEMO_DDM
1918 
1931 static uint16_t MmwDemo_convertRangeCfarToThresh(uint16_t codedCfarVal, uint8_t numBands)
1932 {
1933  uint16_t linearVal;
1934  float dbVal, linVal;
1935  uint32_t defaultScaling = 1 << 11;
1936  float additionalScaling = numBands / (float)(1 << mathUtils_ceilLog2(numBands));
1937 
1938  /* dbVal is a float value from 0-100dB. It needs to
1939  be converted to linear scale..
1940  First, recover float dbVal that was encoded in CLI. */
1941  dbVal = (float)(codedCfarVal / MMWDEMO_CFAR_THRESHOLD_ENCODING_FACTOR);
1942 
1943  /* Now convert it to linear value */
1944  linVal = (uint32_t)(log2f(pow(10, (float)dbVal/20.0)) * additionalScaling * defaultScaling + 0.5);
1945 
1946  linearVal = (uint16_t) linVal;
1947  return (linearVal);
1948 }

1963 #define CONST_LOG2_10 (3.3219)
1964 static uint16_t MmwDemo_convertDopplerCfarToThresh(uint16_t codedCfarVal)
1965 {
1966  uint16_t linearVal;
1967  float dbVal, linVal;
1968 
1969  /* dbVal is a float value from 0-100dB. It needs to
1970  be converted to linear scale..
1971  First, recover float dbVal that was encoded in CLI. */
1972  dbVal = (float)(codedCfarVal / MMWDEMO_CFAR_THRESHOLD_ENCODING_FACTOR);
1973 
1974  /* Now convert it to linear value */
1975  linVal = (uint32_t)(dbVal/20.0 * CONST_LOG2_10 * 2048.0);
1976 
1977  linearVal = (uint16_t) linVal;
1978  return (linearVal);
1979 }
1980 #endif

1995 static int32_t MmwDemo_dataPathConfig (void)
1996 {
1997  int32_t errCode;
1998  MMWave_CtrlCfg *ptrCtrlCfg;
1999  MmwDemo_DPC_ObjDet_CommonCfg *objDetCommonCfg;
2000  MmwDemo_SubFrameCfg *subFrameCfg;
2001  int8_t subFrameIndx;
2002  MmwDemo_RFParserOutParams RFparserOutParams;
2003  DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCfg objDetPreStartCfg;
2004  DPC_ObjectDetection_StaticCfg *staticCfg;
2005 #ifdef MMWDEMO_DDM
2006  bool procChain = 1;
2007 #elif defined(MMWDEMO_TDM)
2008  bool procChain = 0;
2009 #endif
2010  /* Get data path object and control configuration */
2011  ptrCtrlCfg = &gMmwMssMCB.cfg.ctrlCfg;
2012 
2013  objDetCommonCfg = &gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg;
2014  staticCfg = &objDetPreStartCfg.staticCfg;
2015 
2016 #ifdef MMWDEMO_DDM
2017  {
2018  /* Calculating the maximum ADC Samples across all frames, useful for common array allocations */
2019  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.maxAdcSamples = 0U;
2020  for(subFrameIndx = 0; subFrameIndx < gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.numSubFrames;
2021  subFrameIndx++)
2022  {
2023  subFrameCfg = &gMmwMssMCB.subFrameCfg[subFrameIndx];
2024  if(subFrameCfg->numAdcSamples > gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.maxAdcSamples)
2025  {
2026  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.maxAdcSamples = subFrameCfg->numAdcSamples;
2027  }
2028  }
2029  }
2030 #endif
2031 
2032  gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.numSubFrames =
2033  MmwDemo_RFParser_getNumSubFrames(ptrCtrlCfg);
2034 
2035  DebugP_logInfo("App: Issuing Pre-start Common Config IOCTL\n");
2036 
2037  /* Get RF frequency scale factor */
2038  gMmwMssMCB.rfFreqScaleFactor = MMWDEMO_RF_FREQ_SCALE_FACTOR;
2039 
2040  /* DPC pre-start common config */
2041  errCode = MmwDemo_DPM_ioctl_blocking (gMmwMssMCB.objDetDpmHandle,
2042  DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__STATIC_PRE_START_COMMON_CFG,
2043  &objDetCommonCfg->preStartCommonCfg,
2044  sizeof (DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCommonCfg));
2045 
2046  if (errCode < 0)
2047  {
2048  test_print ("Error: Unable to send DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__STATIC_PRE_START_COMMON_CFG [Error:%d]\n", errCode);
2049  goto exit;
2050  }
2051 
2052  MmwDemo_resetDynObjDetCommonCfgPendingState(&gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg);
2053 
2054  /* Reason for reverse loop is that when sensor is started, the first sub-frame
2055  * will be active and the ADC configuration needs to be done for that sub-frame
2056  * before starting (ADC buf hardware does not have notion of sub-frame, it will
2057  * be reconfigured every sub-frame). This cannot be alternatively done by calling
2058  * the MmwDemo_ADCBufConfig function only for the first sub-frame because this is
2059  * a utility API that computes the rxChanOffset that is part of ADC dataProperty
2060  * which will be used by range DPU and therefore this computation is required for
2061  * all sub-frames.
2062  */
2063  for(subFrameIndx = gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.numSubFrames -1; subFrameIndx >= 0;
2064  subFrameIndx--)
2065  {
2066  subFrameCfg = &gMmwMssMCB.subFrameCfg[subFrameIndx];
2067 
2068  /*****************************************************************************
2069  * Data path :: Algorithm Configuration
2070  *****************************************************************************/
2071 
2072  /* Parse the profile and chirp configs and get the valid number of TX Antennas */
2073  errCode = MmwDemo_RFParser_parseConfig(&RFparserOutParams, subFrameIndx,
2074  &gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg, ptrCtrlCfg,
2075  &subFrameCfg->adcBufCfg,
2076  gMmwMssMCB.rfFreqScaleFactor,
2077  false, procChain);
2078 
2079  /* if number of doppler chirps is too low, interpolate to be able to detect
2080  * better with CFAR tuning. E.g. a 2-pt FFT will be problematic in terms
2081  * of distinguishing direction of motion */
2082  if (RFparserOutParams.numDopplerChirps <= 4)
2083  {
2084  RFparserOutParams.dopplerStep = RFparserOutParams.dopplerStep / (8 / RFparserOutParams.numDopplerBins);
2085  RFparserOutParams.numDopplerBins = 8;
2086  }
2087 
2088  if (errCode != 0)
2089  {
2090  test_print ("Error: MmwDemo_RFParser_parseConfig [Error:%d]\n", errCode);
2091  goto exit;
2092  }
2093 
2094  subFrameCfg->numRangeBins = RFparserOutParams.numRangeBins;
2095  /* Workaround for range DPU limitation for FFT size 1024 and 12 virtual antennas case*/
2096  if ((RFparserOutParams.numVirtualAntennas == 12) && (RFparserOutParams.numRangeBins == 1024))
2097  {
2098  subFrameCfg->numRangeBins = 1022;
2099  RFparserOutParams.numRangeBins = 1022;
2100  }
2101 
2102 #ifdef MMWDEMO_DDM
2103  subFrameCfg->datapathStaticCfg.compressionCfg.numRxAntennaPerBlock = RFparserOutParams.numRxAntennas;
2104  if(subFrameCfg->datapathStaticCfg.compressionCfg.compressionMethod == 1)
2105  { /* BFP Compression */
2106  subFrameCfg->datapathStaticCfg.compressionCfg.bfpCompExtraParamSets = 2*(RFparserOutParams.numRxAntennas -1);
2107  }
2108  else
2109  {
2110  subFrameCfg->datapathStaticCfg.compressionCfg.bfpCompExtraParamSets = 0;
2111  }
2112 #endif
2113  subFrameCfg->numDopplerBins = RFparserOutParams.numDopplerBins;
2114  subFrameCfg->numChirpsPerChirpEvent = RFparserOutParams.numChirpsPerChirpEvent;
2115  subFrameCfg->adcBufChanDataSize = RFparserOutParams.adcBufChanDataSize;
2116 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
2117  subFrameCfg->objDetDynCfg.dynCfg.prepareRangeAzimuthHeatMap = subFrameCfg->guiMonSel.rangeAzimuthHeatMap;
2118 #endif
2119  subFrameCfg->numAdcSamples = RFparserOutParams.numAdcSamples;
2120  subFrameCfg->numChirpsPerSubFrame = RFparserOutParams.numChirpsPerFrame;
2121  subFrameCfg->numVirtualAntennas = RFparserOutParams.numVirtualAntennas;
2122 
2123  errCode = MmwDemo_ADCBufConfig(gMmwMssMCB.adcBufHandle,
2124  gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.chCfg.rxChannelEn,
2125  subFrameCfg->numChirpsPerChirpEvent,
2126  subFrameCfg->adcBufChanDataSize,
2127  &subFrameCfg->adcBufCfg,
2128  &staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.rxChanOffset[0]);
2129  if (errCode < 0)

2131  test_print("Error: ADCBuf config failed with error[%d]\n", errCode);
2132  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
2133  }
2134 
2135  errCode = MmwDemo_configCQ(subFrameCfg, subFrameCfg->numChirpsPerChirpEvent,
2136  RFparserOutParams.validProfileIdx);
2137  if (errCode < 0)
2138  {
2139  test_print("Error: CQ config failed with error[%d]\n", errCode);
2140  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
2141  }
2142 
2143  /* DPC pre-start config */
2144  {
2145  int32_t idx;
2146 
2147  objDetPreStartCfg.subFrameNum = subFrameIndx;
2148 
2149  /* Fill static configuration */

2155 
2156  staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.dataFmt = DPIF_DATAFORMAT_REAL16;
2157 
2158  if (subFrameCfg->adcBufCfg.chInterleave == 0)
2159  {
2160  staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.interleave = DPIF_RXCHAN_INTERLEAVE_MODE;
2161  }
2162  else
2163  {
2164  staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.interleave = DPIF_RXCHAN_NON_INTERLEAVE_MODE;
2165  }
2166  staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numAdcSamples = RFparserOutParams.numAdcSamples;
2167  staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numChirpsPerChirpEvent = RFparserOutParams.numChirpsPerChirpEvent;
2168  staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataProperty.numRxAntennas = RFparserOutParams.numRxAntennas;
2169  staticCfg->ADCBufData.dataSize = RFparserOutParams.numRxAntennas * RFparserOutParams.numAdcSamples * sizeof(cmplx16ImRe_t);
2170  staticCfg->dopplerStep = RFparserOutParams.dopplerStep;
2171  staticCfg->isValidProfileHasOneTxPerChirp = RFparserOutParams.validProfileHasOneTxPerChirp;
2172  staticCfg->numChirpsPerFrame = RFparserOutParams.numChirpsPerFrame;
2173  staticCfg->numDopplerBins = RFparserOutParams.numDopplerBins;
2174 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
2175  staticCfg->numDopplerChirps = RFparserOutParams.numDopplerChirps;
2176 #endif
2177 #ifdef MMWDEMO_DDM
2178 
2179  staticCfg->ADCBufConfig.rxChannelEn = gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.chCfg.rxChannelEn;
2180  staticCfg->ADCBufConfig.adcBufChanDataSize = RFparserOutParams.adcBufChanDataSize;
2181 
2182  staticCfg->numChirps = RFparserOutParams.numDopplerChirps;
2183  /* Sum Tx must be enabled if range profile is to be sent out or
2184  range CFAR is enabled */
2185 
2186  staticCfg->isSumTxEnabled = (subFrameCfg->datapathStaticCfg.rangeCfarCfg.cfg.isEnabled) ||
2187  (subFrameCfg->guiMonSel.logMagRange) ||
2188  (subFrameCfg->guiMonSel.noiseProfile) ||
2189  (subFrameCfg->guiMonSel.rangeDopplerHeatMap)||
2190  (gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.measureRxChannelBiasCfg.enabled);
2191 
2192 #endif
2193  staticCfg->numRangeBins = RFparserOutParams.numRangeBins;
2194  /* Number of range bins are half the number of FFT Bins in case of real only chirp data */
2195  if(RFparserOutParams.adcDataFmtIsReal){
2196  staticCfg->numRangeFFTBins = (RFparserOutParams.numRangeBins)*(2);
2197  }
2198  else{
2199  staticCfg->numRangeFFTBins = (RFparserOutParams.numRangeBins);
2200  }
2201  staticCfg->numTxAntennas = RFparserOutParams.numTxAntennas;
2202  staticCfg->numVirtualAntAzim = RFparserOutParams.numVirtualAntAzim;
2203  staticCfg->numVirtualAntElev = RFparserOutParams.numVirtualAntElev;
2204  staticCfg->numVirtualAntennas = RFparserOutParams.numVirtualAntennas;
2205  staticCfg->rangeStep = RFparserOutParams.rangeStep;
2206 #ifdef MMWDEMO_DDM
2207  staticCfg->numBandsTotal = staticCfg->numTxAntennas + MmwDemo_getNumEmptySubBands(staticCfg->numTxAntennas);
2208 #endif
2209 
2210  if(staticCfg->numRangeFFTBins > 1024 ){
2211  staticCfg->rangeFFTtuning.fftOutputDivShift = 0;
2212  staticCfg->rangeFFTtuning.numLastButterflyStagesToScale = 3; /* scale only 3 stages */
2213  }
2214  else if (staticCfg->numRangeFFTBins >= 1022)
2215  {
2216  staticCfg->rangeFFTtuning.fftOutputDivShift = 0;
2217  staticCfg->rangeFFTtuning.numLastButterflyStagesToScale = 2; /* scale only 2 stages */
2218  } else if (staticCfg->numRangeFFTBins == 512)
2219  {
2220  staticCfg->rangeFFTtuning.fftOutputDivShift = 1;
2221  staticCfg->rangeFFTtuning.numLastButterflyStagesToScale = 1; /* scale last stage */
2222  } else
2223  {
2224  staticCfg->rangeFFTtuning.fftOutputDivShift = 2;
2225  staticCfg->rangeFFTtuning.numLastButterflyStagesToScale = 0; /* no scaling needed as ADC data is 16-bit and we have 8 bits to grow */
2226  }
2227 
2228  for (idx = 0; idx < RFparserOutParams.numRxAntennas; idx++)
2229  {
2230  staticCfg->rxAntOrder[idx] = RFparserOutParams.rxAntOrder[idx];
2231  }
2232  for (idx = 0; idx < RFparserOutParams.numTxAntennas; idx++)
2233  {
2234  staticCfg->txAntOrder[idx] = RFparserOutParams.txAntOrder[idx];
2235  }
2236 
2237 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
2238  /* Convert CFAR threshold value */
2239  subFrameCfg->objDetDynCfg.dynCfg.cfarCfgRange.thresholdScale =
2240  MmwDemo_convertCfarToLinear(subFrameCfg->objDetDynCfg.dynCfg.cfarCfgRange.thresholdScale,
2241  staticCfg->numVirtualAntennas);
2242 
2243  subFrameCfg->objDetDynCfg.dynCfg.cfarCfgDoppler.thresholdScale =
2244  MmwDemo_convertCfarToLinear(subFrameCfg->objDetDynCfg.dynCfg.cfarCfgDoppler.thresholdScale,
2245  staticCfg->numVirtualAntennas);
2246 
2247  /* Fill dynamic configuration for the sub-frame */
2248  objDetPreStartCfg.dynCfg = subFrameCfg->objDetDynCfg.dynCfg;
2249 #endif
2250 
2251  DebugP_logInfo("App: Issuing Pre-start Config IOCTL (subFrameIndx = %d)\n", subFrameIndx);
2252 
2253 #ifdef MMWDEMO_DDM
2254 
2255  /* Copy out the DPC Static cfg params */
2256 
2257  staticCfg->cfarCfg.subFrameNum = subFrameIndx;
2258 
2259  subFrameCfg->datapathStaticCfg.cfarCfg.cfg.thresholdScale =
2260  MmwDemo_convertDopplerCfarToThresh(subFrameCfg->datapathStaticCfg.cfarCfg.cfg.thresholdScale); //staticCfg->numVirtualAntennas);
2261  memcpy(&staticCfg->cfarCfg.cfg, &subFrameCfg->datapathStaticCfg.cfarCfg.cfg, sizeof(DPU_DopplerProc_CfarCfg));

2265  memcpy(&staticCfg->aoaFovCfg, &subFrameCfg->datapathStaticCfg.aoaFovCfg, sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_FovAoaCfg));
2266 
2267  staticCfg->rangeCfarCfg.subFrameNum = subFrameIndx;
2268  subFrameCfg->datapathStaticCfg.rangeCfarCfg.cfg.thresholdScale =
2269  MmwDemo_convertRangeCfarToThresh(subFrameCfg->datapathStaticCfg.rangeCfarCfg.cfg.thresholdScale, staticCfg->numBandsTotal);
2270  memcpy(&staticCfg->rangeCfarCfg.cfg, &subFrameCfg->datapathStaticCfg.rangeCfarCfg.cfg, sizeof(DPU_CFARProc_CfarCfg));
2271 #endif
2272  /* send pre-start config */
2273  errCode = MmwDemo_DPM_ioctl_blocking (gMmwMssMCB.objDetDpmHandle,

2282  if (errCode < 0)

2288  }

2301 static void MmwDemo_dataPathStart (void)
2302 {
2303  int32_t retVal;
2304 
2305  DebugP_logInfo("App: Issuing DPM_start\n");
2306 #ifdef LVDS_STREAM
2307  /* Configure HW LVDS stream for the first sub-frame that will start upon
2308  * start of frame */
2309  if (gMmwMssMCB.subFrameCfg[0].lvdsStreamCfg.dataFmt != MMW_DEMO_LVDS_STREAM_CFG_DATAFMT_DISABLED)
2310  {
2311  MmwDemo_configLVDSHwData(0);
2312  }
2313 #endif
2314 
2315  /* Start the DPM Profile: */
2316  if ((retVal = DPM_start(gMmwMssMCB.objDetDpmHandle)) < 0)
2317  {
2318  /* Error: Unable to start the profile */
2319  test_print("Error: Unable to start the DPM [Error: %d]\n", retVal);
2320  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
2321  }
2322 
2323  /* Wait until start completed */
2324  SemaphoreP_pend(&gMmwMssMCB.DPMstartSemHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
2325 
2326  DebugP_logInfo("App: DPM_start Done (post SemaphoreP_pend on reportFxn reporting start)\n");
2327 }

2387 static int32_t MmwDemo_eventCallbackFxn(uint8_t devIndex, uint16_t msgId, uint16_t sbId, uint16_t sbLen, uint8_t *payload)
2388 {
2389  uint16_t asyncSB = RL_GET_SBID_FROM_UNIQ_SBID(sbId);
2390 
2391  /* Process the received message: */
2392  switch (msgId)
2393  {
2394  case RL_RF_ASYNC_EVENT_MSG:
2395  {
2396  /* Received Asychronous Message: */
2397  switch (asyncSB)
2398  {
2399  case RL_RF_AE_CPUFAULT_SB:
2400  {
2401  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
2402  break;
2403  }
2404  case RL_RF_AE_ESMFAULT_SB:
2405  {
2406  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
2407  break;
2408  }
2409  case RL_RF_AE_ANALOG_FAULT_SB:
2410  {
2411  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
2412  break;
2413  }
2414  case RL_RF_AE_INITCALIBSTATUS_SB:
2415  {
2416  rlRfInitComplete_t* ptrRFInitCompleteMessage;
2417  uint32_t calibrationStatus;
2418 
2419  /* Get the RF-Init completion message: */
2420  ptrRFInitCompleteMessage = (rlRfInitComplete_t*)payload;
2421  calibrationStatus = ptrRFInitCompleteMessage->calibStatus & 0x1FFFU;
2422 
2423  /* Display the calibration status: */
2424  CLI_write ("Debug: Init Calibration Status = 0x%x\n", calibrationStatus);
2425  break;
2426  }
2427  case RL_RF_AE_FRAME_TRIGGER_RDY_SB:
2428  {
2429  gMmwMssMCB.stats.frameTriggerReady++;
2430  break;
2431  }
2432  case RL_RF_AE_MON_TIMING_FAIL_REPORT_SB:
2433  {
2434  gMmwMssMCB.stats.failedTimingReports++;
2435  break;
2436  }
2437  case RL_RF_AE_RUN_TIME_CALIB_REPORT_SB:
2438  {
2439  gMmwMssMCB.stats.calibrationReports++;
2440  break;
2441  }
2442  case RL_RF_AE_FRAME_END_SB:
2443  {
2444  gMmwMssMCB.stats.sensorStopped++;
2445  DebugP_logInfo("App: BSS stop (frame end) received\n");
2446 
2447  MmwDemo_dataPathStop();
2448  break;
2449  }
2450  default:
2451  {
2452  test_print ("Error: Asynchronous Event SB Id %d not handled\n", asyncSB);
2453  break;
2454  }
2455  }
2456  break;
2457  }
2458  /* Async Event from MMWL */
2459  case RL_MMWL_ASYNC_EVENT_MSG:
2460  {
2461  switch (asyncSB)
2462  {
2463  case RL_MMWL_AE_MISMATCH_REPORT:
2464  {
2465  /* link reports protocol error in the async report from BSS */
2466  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
2467  break;
2468  }
2469  case RL_MMWL_AE_INTERNALERR_REPORT:
2470  {
2471  /* link reports internal error during BSS communication */
2472  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
2473  break;
2474  }
2475  }
2476  break;
2477  }
2478  /* Async Event from MSS */
2479  case RL_DEV_ASYNC_EVENT_MSG:
2480  {
2481  switch (asyncSB)
2482  {
2483  case RL_DEV_AE_MSSPOWERUPDONE_SB:
2484  {
2485  test_print("Received RL_DEV_AE_MSSPOWERUPDONE_SB\n");
2486 
2487  }
2488  break;
2489  default:
2490  {
2491  test_print("Unhandled Async Event msgId: 0x%x, asyncSB:0x%x \n\n", msgId, asyncSB);
2492  break;
2493  }
2494  }
2495  break;
2496 
2497  }
2498  default:
2499  {
2500  test_print ("Error: Asynchronous message %d is NOT handled\n", msgId);
2501  break;
2502  }
2503  }
2504  return 0;
2505 }

2527 static void MmwDemo_DPC_ObjectDetection_reportFxn
2528 (
2529  DPM_Report reportType,
2530  uint32_t instanceId,
2531  int32_t errCode,
2532  uint32_t arg0,
2533  uint32_t arg1
2534 )
2535 {
2536  /* Only errors are logged on the console: */
2537  if ((errCode != 0) || (instanceId != DPC_OBJDET_INSTANCEID))
2538  {
2539  /* Error: Detected log on the console and die all errors are FATAL currently. */
2540  test_print ("Error: DPM Report %d received with error:%d arg0:0x%x arg1:0x%x\n",
2541  reportType, errCode, arg0, arg1);
2542  DebugP_assert (0);
2543  }
2544 
2545  /* Processing further is based on the reports received: This is the control of the profile
2546  * state machine: */
2547  switch (reportType)
2548  {
2549  case DPM_Report_IOCTL:
2550  {
2551 
2552  /*****************************************************************
2553  * DPC has been configured without an error:
2554  * - This is an indication that the profile configuration commands
2555  * went through without any issues.
2556  *****************************************************************/
2557  DebugP_logInfo("App: DPM Report IOCTL, command = %d\n", arg0);
2558 
2559  if (arg0 == DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__STATIC_PRE_START_CFG)
2560  {
2561  DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCfg *cfg;
2562  DPC_ObjectDetection_DPC_IOCTL_preStartCfg_memUsage *memUsage;
2563 
2564  cfg = (DPC_ObjectDetection_PreStartCfg*)arg1;
2565 
2566  memUsage = &cfg->memUsage;
2567 
2568  test_print("============ Heap Memory Stats ============\n");
2569  test_print("%20s %12s %12s %12s %12s\n", " ", "Size", "Used", "Free", "DPCUsed");
2570 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
2571  test_print("%20s %12d %12d %12d %12d\n", "System Heap(L2)",
2572  memUsage->SystemHeapTotal, memUsage->SystemHeapUsed,
2573  memUsage->SystemHeapTotal - memUsage->SystemHeapUsed,
2574  memUsage->SystemHeapDPCUsed);
2575 #endif
2576 
2577  test_print("%20s %12d %12d %12d\n", "L3",
2578  memUsage->L3RamTotal,
2579  memUsage->L3RamUsage,
2580  memUsage->L3RamTotal - memUsage->L3RamUsage);
2581 
2582  test_print("%20s %12d %12d %12d\n", "localRam(L2)",
2583  memUsage->CoreLocalRamTotal,
2584  memUsage->CoreLocalRamUsage,
2585  memUsage->CoreLocalRamTotal - memUsage->CoreLocalRamUsage);
2586  }
2587 
2588  switch(arg0)
2589  {
2590  /* The following ioctls take longer time to finish. It causes DPM to queue IOCTL requests on DSS before
2591  * they are handled. However DPM has limited pipe queues, hence adding sync points in demo to avoid
2592  * sending too many such ioctls to DSS at a time.
2593  * The semaphore blocks CLI task to wait for the response from DSS before sending the next ioctl.
2594  */
2595  case DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__STATIC_PRE_START_CFG:
2596  case DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__STATIC_PRE_START_COMMON_CFG:
2597  SemaphoreP_post(&gMmwMssMCB.DPMioctlSemHandle);
2598  break;
2599  default:
2600  break;
2601  }
2602  break;
2603  }
2604  case DPM_Report_DPC_STARTED:
2605  {
2606  /*****************************************************************
2607  * DPC has been started without an error:
2608  * - notify sensor management task that DPC is started.
2609  *****************************************************************/
2610  DebugP_logInfo("App: DPM Report DPC Started\n");
2611  SemaphoreP_post(&gMmwMssMCB.DPMstartSemHandle);
2612  break;
2613  }
2614  case DPM_Report_NOTIFY_DPC_RESULT:
2615  {
2616  /*****************************************************************
2617  * datapath has finished frame processing, results are reported
2618  *****************************************************************/
2619 
2620  DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResultExportedInfo exportInfo;
2621  int32_t retVal=0;
2622 
2623  if(gMmwMssMCB.stats.isLastFrameDataProcessed)
2624  {
2625  /* reset Frame data processed flag, set after full obj data is actually streamed out */
2626  gMmwMssMCB.stats.isLastFrameDataProcessed = false;
2627  memcpy((void*)(&gMmwMssMCB.ptrResult), (void*)arg0, sizeof(DPM_Buffer));
2628  exportInfo.subFrameIdx = ((DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult *)gMmwMssMCB.ptrResult.ptrBuffer[0])->subFrameIdx;
2629  /* Send notification to data path after results are handled */
2630  retVal = DPM_ioctl (gMmwMssMCB.objDetDpmHandle,
2631  DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__DYNAMIC_EXECUTE_RESULT_EXPORTED,
2632  &exportInfo,
2633  sizeof (DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResultExportedInfo));
2634  if (retVal < 0) {
2635  test_print ("Error: DPM DPC_OBJDET_IOCTL__DYNAMIC_EXECUTE_RESULT_EXPORTED failed [Error code %d]\n",
2636  retVal);
2637  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
2638  }
2639  /* signal the UART task to transmit the data */
2640  SemaphoreP_post(&gMmwMssMCB.UartExportSemHandle);
2641  }
2642  else{
2643  volatile uint32_t transmitTime = (CycleCounterP_getCount32() - transmitStartTime)/(SOC_getSelfCpuClk()/1000000U);
2644  test_print ("UART processing not completed: numObjOut %d Time %d\n", ((DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult *)gMmwMssMCB.ptrResult.ptrBuffer[0])->numObjOut, transmitTime);
2645  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
2646  }
2647  break;
2648  }
2649  case DPM_Report_DPC_ASSERT:
2650  {
2651  DPM_DPCAssert* ptrAssert;
2652 
2653  /*****************************************************************
2654  * DPC Fault has been detected:
2655  * - This implies that the DPC has crashed.
2656  * - The argument0 points to the DPC assertion information
2657  *****************************************************************/
2658  ptrAssert = (DPM_DPCAssert*)arg0;
2659  CLI_write("Obj Det DPC Exception: %s, line %d.\n", ptrAssert->fileName,
2660  ptrAssert->lineNum);
2661  break;
2662  }
2663  case DPM_Report_DPC_STOPPED:
2664  {
2665  /*****************************************************************
2666  * DPC has been stopped without an error:
2667  * - This implies that the DPC can either be reconfigured or
2668  * restarted.
2669  *****************************************************************/
2670  DebugP_logInfo("App: DPM Report DPC Stopped\n");
2671  SemaphoreP_post(&gMmwMssMCB.DPMstopSemHandle);
2672  break;
2673  }
2674  case DPM_Report_DPC_INFO:
2675  case DPM_Report_NOTIFY_DPC_RESULT_ACKED:
2676  {
2677  /* Currently objDetHwa does not use this feature. */
2678  break;
2679  }
2680  default:
2681  {
2682  DebugP_assert (0);
2683  break;
2684  }
2685  }
2686  return;
2687 }

2972 /* Workaround for Errata ANA#46: Spurs caused due to data transfer activity */
2973 static void MmwDPC_chirpAvailISR(void* arg)
2974 {

2976  CSL_rss_ctrlRegs *ptr_rss_ctrl_regs = (CSL_rss_ctrlRegs*)CSL_RSS_CTRL_U_BASE;

2978  if(gMmwMssMCB.adcDataDithDelayCfg.isDitherEn == 1U)

2981  delay = rand() % gMmwMssMCB.adcDataDithDelayCfg.ditherVal;
2982 
2983  ptr_rss_ctrl_regs->ADCBUFCFG1_EXTD = delay + MMWDEMO_DITHERING_MINDELAY;
2984  }
2985 }

2987 /* Workaround for Errata ANA#46: Spurs caused due to data transfer activity */
2988 static int32_t MmwDemo_registerChirpStartInterrupt(void)
2989 {
2990  int32_t retVal = 0;
2991  int32_t status = SystemP_SUCCESS;
2992  HwiP_Params hwiPrms;
2993 
2994  /* Register interrupt */
2995  HwiP_Params_init(&hwiPrms);
2996  hwiPrms.intNum = CSL_MSS_INTR_RSS_ADC_CAPTURE_COMPLETE_DITH;
2997  hwiPrms.callback = &MmwDPC_chirpAvailISR;
2998  hwiPrms.priority = 2;
2999  status = HwiP_construct(&gMmwMssMCB.adcDataDithDelayCfg.chirpAvailHwiObject, &hwiPrms);
3000  if (SystemP_SUCCESS != status)
3001  {
3002  retVal = SystemP_FAILURE;
3003  }
3004  else
3005  {
3006  /* Keep the interrupt disable: Interrupt should be enabled once dithering enable request is received from CLI */
3007  HwiP_disableInt((uint32_t)CSL_MSS_INTR_RSS_ADC_CAPTURE_COMPLETE_DITH);
3008  }
3009  return retVal;
3010 }

3020 void MmwDemo_handleObjectDetResult(void)
3021 {
3022  DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult *dpcResults;
3023  MmwDemo_output_message_stats *frameStats;
3024  volatile uint32_t startTime;
3025  uint8_t nextSubFrameIdx;
3026  uint8_t numSubFrames;
3027  uint8_t currSubFrameIdx;
3028  uint8_t prevSubFrameIdx;
3029  MmwDemo_SubFrameStats *currSubFrameStats;
3030  MmwDemo_SubFrameStats *prevSubFrameStats;
3031 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
3032  int32_t retVal;
3033 #endif
3034  /*****************************************************************
3035  * datapath has finished frame processing, results are reported
3036  *****************************************************************/
3037 
3038  /* Validate DPC results buffer */
3039  DebugP_assert (gMmwMssMCB.ptrResult.size[0] == sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult));
3040 
3041  /* Translate the address: */
3042  dpcResults = (DPC_ObjectDetection_ExecuteResult *) AddrTranslateP_getLocalAddr((uint32_t)gMmwMssMCB.ptrResult.ptrBuffer[0]);
3043 
3044  /* Validate timing Info buffer */
3045  DebugP_assert (gMmwMssMCB.ptrResult.size[1] == sizeof(MmwDemo_output_message_stats));
3046 
3047  numSubFrames = gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.numSubFrames;
3048  currSubFrameIdx = dpcResults->subFrameIdx;
3049  prevSubFrameIdx = MmwDemo_getPrevSubFrameIndx(currSubFrameIdx, numSubFrames);
3050  currSubFrameStats = &gMmwMssMCB.subFrameStats[currSubFrameIdx];
3051  prevSubFrameStats = &gMmwMssMCB.subFrameStats[prevSubFrameIdx];
3052 
3053  /*****************************************************************
3054  * Transmit results
3055  *****************************************************************/
3056  startTime = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
3057 
3058 
3059  /* Send out of CLI the range bias and phase config measurement if it was enabled. */
3060  if (gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.measureRxChannelBiasCfg.enabled == 1)
3061  {
3062  if(dpcResults->compRxChanBiasMeasurement != NULL)
3063  {
3064 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
3065  dpcResults->compRxChanBiasMeasurement = (DPU_AoAProc_compRxChannelBiasCfg *) AddrTranslateP_getLocalAddr((uint32_t)dpcResults->compRxChanBiasMeasurement);
3066 #elif defined(MMWDEMO_DDM)
3067  dpcResults->compRxChanBiasMeasurement = (Measure_compRxChannelBiasCfg *) AddrTranslateP_getLocalAddr((uint32_t)dpcResults->compRxChanBiasMeasurement);
3068 #endif
3069  MmwDemo_measurementResultOutput((void*)dpcResults->compRxChanBiasMeasurement);
3070  }
3071  else
3072  {
3073  /* DPC is not ready to ship the measurement results */
3074  }
3075  }
3076 
3077  /* Translate the address: */
3078  frameStats = (MmwDemo_output_message_stats *) AddrTranslateP_getLocalAddr((uint32_t)gMmwMssMCB.ptrResult.ptrBuffer[1]);
3079 
3080  /* Update current frame stats */
3081  currSubFrameStats->outputStats.interFrameCPULoad = frameStats->interFrameCPULoad;
3082  currSubFrameStats->outputStats.activeFrameCPULoad= frameStats->activeFrameCPULoad;
3083  currSubFrameStats->outputStats.interChirpProcessingMargin = frameStats->interChirpProcessingMargin;
3084  currSubFrameStats->outputStats.interFrameProcessingTime = frameStats->interFrameProcessingTime;
3085  prevSubFrameStats->outputStats.interFrameProcessingMargin = frameStats->interFrameProcessingMargin;
3086  currSubFrameStats->outputStats.interFrameProcessingMargin = currSubFrameStats->outputStats.interFrameProcessingMargin -
3087  (currSubFrameStats->pendingConfigProcTime + currSubFrameStats->subFramePreparationTime);
3088 #ifdef LVDS_STREAM
3089  if (gMmwMssMCB.subFrameCfg[currSubFrameIdx].lvdsStreamCfg.dataFmt !=
3090  MMW_DEMO_LVDS_STREAM_CFG_DATAFMT_DISABLED)
3091  {
3092  /* check Edma errors (which are considered fatal) for the current sub-frame's
3093  * h/w session that is expected to be completed by now */
3094  MmwDemo_checkEdmaErrors();
3095 
3096  /* Pend for completion of h/w session, generally this will not wait
3097  * because of time spent doing inter-frame processing is expected to
3098  * be bigger than the transmission of the h/w session */
3099  SemaphoreP_pend(&gMmwMssMCB.lvdsStream.hwFrameDoneSemHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
3100  }
3101 #endif
3102 
3103  /* Transmit processing results for the frame */
3104  transmitStartTime = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
3105  MmwDemo_transmitProcessedOutput(gMmwMssMCB.loggingUartHandle,
3106  dpcResults,
3107  &currSubFrameStats->outputStats);
3108 
3109  /* Update current frame transmit time */
3110  currSubFrameStats->outputStats.transmitOutputTime = (CycleCounterP_getCount32() - startTime)/(SOC_getSelfCpuClk()/1000000U); /* In micro seconds */
3111 
3112  /*****************************************************************
3113  * Handle dynamic pending configuration
3114  * For non-advanced frame case:
3115  * process all pending dynamic config commands.
3116  * For advanced-frame case:
3117  * Process next sub-frame related pending dynamic config commands.
3118  * If the next sub-frame was the first sub-frame of the frame,
3119  * then process common (sub-frame independent) pending dynamic config
3120  * commands.
3121  *****************************************************************/
3122  startTime = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
3123 
3124  nextSubFrameIdx = MmwDemo_getNextSubFrameIndx(currSubFrameIdx, numSubFrames);
3125 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
3126  retVal = MmwDemo_processPendingDynamicCfgCommands(nextSubFrameIdx);
3127  if (retVal != 0)
3128  {
3129  test_print ("Error: Executing Pending Dynamic Configuration Commands [Error code %d]\n",
3130  retVal);
3131  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
3132  }
3133 #endif
3134  currSubFrameStats->pendingConfigProcTime = (CycleCounterP_getCount32() - startTime)/(SOC_getSelfCpuClk()/1000000U);
3135 
3136 #ifdef MMWDEMO_TDM
3137  /*****************************************************************
3138  * Prepare for subFrame switch
3139  *****************************************************************/
3140  if(numSubFrames > 1)
3141  {
3142  MmwDemo_SubFrameCfg *nextSubFrameCfg;
3143  uint16_t dummyRxChanOffset[SYS_COMMON_NUM_RX_CHANNEL];
3144 
3145  startTime = CycleCounterP_getCount32();
3146 
3147  nextSubFrameCfg = &gMmwMssMCB.subFrameCfg[nextSubFrameIdx];
3148 
3149  /* Configure ADC for next sub-frame */
3150  retVal = MmwDemo_ADCBufConfig(gMmwMssMCB.adcBufHandle,
3151  gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.chCfg.rxChannelEn,
3152  nextSubFrameCfg->numChirpsPerChirpEvent,
3153  nextSubFrameCfg->adcBufChanDataSize,
3154  &nextSubFrameCfg->adcBufCfg,
3155  &dummyRxChanOffset[0]);
3156  if(retVal < 0)
3157  {
3158  test_print("Error: ADCBuf config failed with error[%d]\n", retVal);
3159  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
3160  }
3161  currSubFrameStats->subFramePreparationTime = (CycleCounterP_getCount32() - startTime)/(SOC_getSelfCpuClk()/1000000U);
3162 
3163 #ifdef LVDS_STREAM
3164  /* Configure HW LVDS stream for this subframe? */
3165  if(nextSubFrameCfg->lvdsStreamCfg.dataFmt != MMW_DEMO_LVDS_STREAM_CFG_DATAFMT_DISABLED)
3166  {

3308 int32_t MmwDemo_openSensor(bool isFirstTimeOpen)
3309 {
3310  int32_t errCode;
3311  MMWave_ErrorLevel errorLevel;
3312  int16_t mmWaveErrorCode;
3313  int16_t subsysErrorCode;
3314  int32_t retVal;
3315  MMWave_CalibrationData calibrationDataCfg;
3316  MMWave_CalibrationData *ptrCalibrationDataCfg;
3317 
3318  /* Open mmWave module, this is only done once */
3319  if (isFirstTimeOpen == true)
3320  {
3321 
3322  /**********************************************************
3323  **********************************************************/
3324 
3325  /* Open mmWave module, this is only done once */
3326  /* Setup the calibration frequency:*/
3327  gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.freqLimitLow = 760U;
3328  gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.freqLimitHigh = 810U;
3329 
3330  /* start/stop async events */
3331  gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.disableFrameStartAsyncEvent = false;
3332  gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.disableFrameStopAsyncEvent = false;
3333 
3334  /* No custom calibration: */
3335  gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.useCustomCalibration = false;
3336  gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.customCalibrationEnableMask = 0x0;
3337 
3338  /* calibration monitoring base time unit
3339  * setting it to one frame duration as the demo doesnt support any
3340  * monitoring related functionality
3341  */
3342  gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.calibMonTimeUnit = 1;
3343 
3344  if( (gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.saveEnable != 0) &&
3345  (gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.restoreEnable != 0) )
3346  {
3347  /* Error: only one can be enabled at at time */
3348  test_print ("Error: MmwDemo failed with both save and restore enabled.\n");
3349  return -1;
3350  }
3351 
3352  if(gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.restoreEnable != 0)
3353  {
3354  if(MmwDemo_calibRestore(&gCalibDataStorage) < 0)
3355  {
3356  test_print ("Error: MmwDemo failed restoring calibration data from flash.\n");
3357  return -1;
3358  }
3359 
3360  /* Boot calibration during restore: Disable calibration for:
3361  - Rx gain,
3362  - Rx IQMM,
3363  - Tx phase shifer,
3364  - Tx Power
3365 
3366  The above calibration data will be restored from flash. Since they are calibrated in a control
3367  way to avoid interfaerence and spec violations.
3368  In this demo, other bit fields(except the above) are enabled as indicated in customCalibrationEnableMask to perform boot time
3369  calibration. The boot time calibration will overwrite the restored calibration data from flash.
3370  However other bit fields can be disabled and calibration data can be restored from flash as well.
3371 
3372  Note: In this demo, calibration masks are enabled for all bit fields when "saving" the data.
3373  */
3374  gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.useCustomCalibration = true;
3375  gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.customCalibrationEnableMask = 0x1F0U;
3376 
3377  calibrationDataCfg.ptrCalibData = &gCalibDataStorage.calibData;
3378  calibrationDataCfg.ptrPhaseShiftCalibData = &gCalibDataStorage.phaseShiftCalibData;
3379  ptrCalibrationDataCfg = &calibrationDataCfg;
3380  }
3381  else
3382  {
3383  ptrCalibrationDataCfg = NULL;
3384  }
3385 
3386 
3387  /* Open the mmWave module: */
3388  if (MMWave_open (gMmwMssMCB.ctrlHandle, &gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg, ptrCalibrationDataCfg, &errCode) < 0)
3389  {
3390  /* Error: decode and Report the error */
3391  MMWave_decodeError (errCode, &errorLevel, &mmWaveErrorCode, &subsysErrorCode);
3392  test_print ("Error: mmWave Open failed [Error code: %d Subsystem: %d]\n",
3393  mmWaveErrorCode, subsysErrorCode);
3394  return -1;
3395  }
3396 
3397  /* Save calibration data in flash */
3398  if(gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.saveEnable != 0)
3399  {
3400  retVal = rlRfCalibDataStore(RL_DEVICE_MAP_INTERNAL_BSS, &gCalibDataStorage.calibData);
3401  if(retVal != RL_RET_CODE_OK)
3402  {
3403  /* Error: Calibration data restore failed */
3404  test_print("MSS demo failed rlRfCalibDataStore with Error[%d]\n", retVal);
3405  return -1;
3406  }
3407 
3408  /* update txIndex in all chunks to get data from all Tx.
3409  This should be done regardless of num TX channels enabled in MMWave_OpenCfg_t::chCfg or number of Tx
3410  application is interested in. Data for all existing Tx channels should be retrieved
3411  from RadarSS and in the order as shown below.
3412  RadarSS will return non-zero phase shift values for all the channels enabled via
3413  MMWave_OpenCfg_t::chCfg and zero phase shift values for channels disabled in MMWave_OpenCfg_t::chCfg */
3414  gCalibDataStorage.phaseShiftCalibData.PhShiftcalibChunk[0].txIndex = 0;
3415  gCalibDataStorage.phaseShiftCalibData.PhShiftcalibChunk[1].txIndex = 1;
3416  gCalibDataStorage.phaseShiftCalibData.PhShiftcalibChunk[2].txIndex = 2;
3417 
3418  /* Basic validation passed: Restore the phase shift calibration data */
3419  retVal = rlRfPhShiftCalibDataStore(RL_DEVICE_MAP_INTERNAL_BSS, &(gCalibDataStorage.phaseShiftCalibData));
3420  if (retVal != RL_RET_CODE_OK)
3421  {
3422  /* Error: Phase shift Calibration data restore failed */
3423  test_print("MSS demo failed rlRfPhShiftCalibDataStore with Error[%d]\n", retVal);
3424  return retVal;
3425  }
3426 
3427  /* Save data in flash */
3428  retVal = MmwDemo_calibSave(&gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.calibDataHdr, &gCalibDataStorage);
3429  if(retVal < 0)
3430  {
3431  return retVal;
3432  }
3433  }
3434 
3435  /* Open the datapath modules that runs on MSS */
3436  MmwDemo_dataPathOpen();
3437  }
3438  return 0;
3439 }

3454 int32_t MmwDemo_configPhaseShifterChirps(void){
3455 
3456  int32_t errCode = 0;
3457  uint16_t chirpIdx, chirpStartIdx, chirpEndIdx, numTxAntAzim, numTxTotalDivisor,
3458  numTxAntElev, txAntMask, txOrderIdx, activeTxCnt, chirpPhaseMultiplier;
3459  /* xth value of this array corresponds to the phase shift multiplier for the xth Tx antenna */
3460  uint16_t phaseShiftMultiplier[SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS];
3461  rlRfPhaseShiftCfg_t phaseShiftCfg;
3462 
3463  memset ((void *)&phaseShiftCfg, 0, sizeof(phaseShiftCfg));
3464 
3465  txAntMask = gMmwMssMCB.cfg.openCfg.chCfg.txChannelEn;
3466  numTxAntAzim = mathUtils_countSetBits(txAntMask & MmwDemo_RFParserHwCfg.azimTxAntMask);
3467  numTxAntElev = mathUtils_countSetBits(txAntMask & MmwDemo_RFParserHwCfg.elevTxAntMask);
3468 
3469  gMmwMssMCB.numEmptySubBands = MmwDemo_getNumEmptySubBands(numTxAntAzim + numTxAntElev);
3470  numTxTotalDivisor = numTxAntAzim + numTxAntElev + gMmwMssMCB.numEmptySubBands;
3471 
3472  activeTxCnt = 0;
3473  /* Get the phase multiplier factor for each Tx antenna */
3474  /* Loop over Tx Antenna Phase order index */
3475  for(txOrderIdx = 0; txOrderIdx < SYS_COMMON_NUM_TX_ANTENNAS; txOrderIdx++){
3476  /* Check if the Tx antenna corresponding to the xth index in the phase order is enabled */
3477  if(1 << gMmwMssMCB.ddmPhaseShiftOrder[txOrderIdx] & txAntMask){
3478  /* Antenna is enabled, hence compute the phase shift value */
3479  phaseShiftMultiplier[gMmwMssMCB.ddmPhaseShiftOrder[txOrderIdx]] = activeTxCnt;
3480  activeTxCnt++;
3481  }
3482  else{
3483  /* Antenna is disabled */
3484  phaseShiftMultiplier[gMmwMssMCB.ddmPhaseShiftOrder[txOrderIdx]] = 0;
3485  }
3486  }
3487 
3488  /* Configure Phase Shifter Chirps */
3489  if(gMmwMssMCB.cfg.ctrlCfg.dfeDataOutputMode == MMWave_DFEDataOutputMode_FRAME){
3490 
3491  chirpStartIdx = gMmwMssMCB.cfg.ctrlCfg.u.frameCfg[0].frameCfg.chirpStartIdx;
3492  chirpEndIdx = gMmwMssMCB.cfg.ctrlCfg.u.frameCfg[0].frameCfg.chirpEndIdx;
3493 
3494  /* Phase multipliers have been computed; phase shift for xth chirp = (x-1) * phase multipler */
3495  for (chirpIdx = chirpStartIdx; chirpIdx <= chirpEndIdx; chirpIdx++){
3496 
3497  chirpPhaseMultiplier = (chirpIdx - chirpStartIdx);
3498 
3499  /* Populate the chirp configuration: */
3500  phaseShiftCfg.chirpStartIdx = (chirpEndIdx + 1 - chirpPhaseMultiplier) % numTxTotalDivisor;
3501  phaseShiftCfg.chirpEndIdx = (chirpEndIdx + 1 - chirpPhaseMultiplier) % numTxTotalDivisor;
3502 
3503  /* 1 LSB of phaseShiftCfg.txPhaseShift = 360/2^6 = 5.625 degrees Valid range: 0 to 63 */
3504  phaseShiftCfg.tx0PhaseShift =
3505  ((uint32_t) MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(((float) ((chirpPhaseMultiplier * phaseShiftMultiplier[0]) % numTxTotalDivisor) / numTxTotalDivisor) * (1U << 6))) << 2;
3506 
3507  /* 1 LSB of phaseShiftCfg.txPhaseShift = 360/2^6 = 5.625 degrees Valid range: 0 to 63 */
3508  phaseShiftCfg.tx1PhaseShift =
3509  ((uint32_t) MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(((float) ((chirpPhaseMultiplier * phaseShiftMultiplier[1]) % numTxTotalDivisor) / numTxTotalDivisor) * (1U << 6))) << 2;
3510 
3511  /* 1 LSB of phaseShiftCfg.txPhaseShift = 360/2^6 = 5.625 degrees Valid range: 0 to 63 */
3512  phaseShiftCfg.tx2PhaseShift =
3513  ((uint32_t) MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(((float) ((chirpPhaseMultiplier * phaseShiftMultiplier[2]) % numTxTotalDivisor) / numTxTotalDivisor) * (1U << 6))) << 2;
3514 
3515 #ifdef SOC_AWR2944
3516  /* 1 LSB of phaseShiftCfg.txPhaseShift = 360/2^6 = 5.625 degrees Valid range: 0 to 63 */
3517  phaseShiftCfg.tx3PhaseShift =
3518  ((uint32_t) MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(((float) ((chirpPhaseMultiplier * phaseShiftMultiplier[3]) % numTxTotalDivisor) / numTxTotalDivisor) * (1U << 6))) << 2;
3519 #endif
3520 
3521  /* Add the chirp to the profile */
3522  if (MMWave_addPhaseShiftChirp (gMmwMssMCB.ctrlHandle, &phaseShiftCfg, &errCode) == NULL)
3523  {
3524  /* Error: Unable to add the phase shifter chirp. Return the error code. */
3525  CLI_write ("Error: Unable to add the phase shifter chirp.\n");
3526  return errCode;
3527  }
3528  }
3529  }
3530 
3531  else if(gMmwMssMCB.cfg.ctrlCfg.dfeDataOutputMode == MMWave_DFEDataOutputMode_ADVANCED_FRAME){
3532  uint8_t numOfSubFrames = gMmwMssMCB.cfg.ctrlCfg.u.advancedFrameCfg[0].frameCfg.frameSeq.numOfSubFrames;
3533  uint8_t subFrameIdx = 0;
3534  for(subFrameIdx =0; subFrameIdx < numOfSubFrames; subFrameIdx++ ){
3535  chirpStartIdx = gMmwMssMCB.cfg.ctrlCfg.u.advancedFrameCfg[0].frameCfg.frameSeq.subFrameCfg[subFrameIdx].chirpStartIdx;
3536  chirpEndIdx = gMmwMssMCB.cfg.ctrlCfg.u.advancedFrameCfg[0].frameCfg.frameSeq.subFrameCfg[subFrameIdx].numOfChirps + chirpStartIdx - 1;
3537 
3538  /* Phase multipliers have been computed; phase shift for xth chirp = (x-1) * phase multipler */
3539  for (chirpIdx = chirpStartIdx; chirpIdx <= chirpEndIdx; chirpIdx++){
3540 
3541  // printf("Chirp %d\n", chirpIdx);
3542  chirpPhaseMultiplier = (chirpIdx - chirpStartIdx);
3543 
3544  /* Populate the chirp configuration: */
3545  phaseShiftCfg.chirpStartIdx = (chirpEndIdx + 1 - chirpPhaseMultiplier) % numTxTotalDivisor + chirpStartIdx;
3546  phaseShiftCfg.chirpEndIdx = (chirpEndIdx + 1 - chirpPhaseMultiplier) % numTxTotalDivisor + chirpStartIdx;
3547 
3548  // printf("phaseShiftCfg.chirpEndIdx: %d\n", phaseShiftCfg.chirpEndIdx);
3549 
3550  /* 1 LSB of phaseShiftCfg.txPhaseShift = 360/2^6 = 5.625 degrees Valid range: 0 to 63 */
3551  phaseShiftCfg.tx0PhaseShift =
3552  ((uint32_t) MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(((float) ((chirpPhaseMultiplier * phaseShiftMultiplier[0]) % numTxTotalDivisor) / numTxTotalDivisor) * (1U << 6))) << 2;
3553 
3554  /* 1 LSB of phaseShiftCfg.txPhaseShift = 360/2^6 = 5.625 degrees Valid range: 0 to 63 */
3555  phaseShiftCfg.tx1PhaseShift =
3556  ((uint32_t) MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(((float) ((chirpPhaseMultiplier * phaseShiftMultiplier[1]) % numTxTotalDivisor) / numTxTotalDivisor) * (1U << 6))) << 2;
3557 
3558  /* 1 LSB of phaseShiftCfg.txPhaseShift = 360/2^6 = 5.625 degrees Valid range: 0 to 63 */
3559  phaseShiftCfg.tx2PhaseShift =
3560  ((uint32_t) MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(((float) ((chirpPhaseMultiplier * phaseShiftMultiplier[2]) % numTxTotalDivisor) / numTxTotalDivisor) * (1U << 6))) << 2;
3561 
3562 #ifdef SOC_AWR2944
3563  /* 1 LSB of phaseShiftCfg.txPhaseShift = 360/2^6 = 5.625 degrees Valid range: 0 to 63 */
3564  phaseShiftCfg.tx3PhaseShift =
3565  ((uint32_t) MATHUTILS_ROUND_FLOAT(((float) ((chirpPhaseMultiplier * phaseShiftMultiplier[3]) % numTxTotalDivisor) / numTxTotalDivisor) * (1U << 6))) << 2;
3566 #endif
3567 
3568  /* Add the chirp to the profile */
3569  if (MMWave_addPhaseShiftChirp (gMmwMssMCB.ctrlHandle, &phaseShiftCfg, &errCode) == NULL)
3570  {
3571  /* Error: Unable to add the phase shifter chirp. Return the error code. */
3572  CLI_write ("Error: Unable to add the phase shifter chirp.\n");
3573  return errCode;
3574  }
3575  // printf("Phase shift values- chirp %d\n", chirpIdx);
3576  // printf("%d\n%d\n%d\n%d\n\n", phaseShiftCfg.tx0PhaseShift/4, phaseShiftCfg.tx1PhaseShift/4, phaseShiftCfg.tx2PhaseShift/4, phaseShiftCfg.tx3PhaseShift/4);
3577  }
3578  }
3579  }
3580 
3581  return errCode;
3582 }

3673 int32_t MmwDemo_startSensor(void)

3677 
3678  /*****************************************************************************
3679  * Data path :: start data path first - this will pend for DPC to ack
3680  *****************************************************************************/
3681  MmwDemo_dataPathStart();
3682 
3683  /*****************************************************************************
3684  * RF :: now start the RF and the real time ticking
3685  *****************************************************************************/
3686  /* Initialize the calibration configuration: */

3688  /* Populate the calibration configuration: */
3689  calibrationCfg.dfeDataOutputMode = gMmwMssMCB.cfg.ctrlCfg.dfeDataOutputMode;
3690  calibrationCfg.u.chirpCalibrationCfg.enableCalibration = true;
3691  calibrationCfg.u.chirpCalibrationCfg.enablePeriodicity = true;
3692  calibrationCfg.u.chirpCalibrationCfg.periodicTimeInFrames = 10U;
3693  calibrationCfg.u.chirpCalibrationCfg.reportEn = 1;
3694 
3695  DebugP_logInfo("App: MMWave_start Issued\n");
3696 
3697  test_print("Starting Sensor (issuing MMWave_start)\n");
3698 
3699  /* Start the mmWave module: The configuration has been applied successfully. */
3700  if (MMWave_start(gMmwMssMCB.ctrlHandle, &calibrationCfg, &errCode) < 0)
3701  {
3702  MMWave_ErrorLevel errorLevel;
3703  int16_t mmWaveErrorCode;
3704  int16_t subsysErrorCode;
3705 
3706  /* Error/Warning: Unable to start the mmWave module */
3707  MMWave_decodeError (errCode, &errorLevel, &mmWaveErrorCode, &subsysErrorCode);
3708  test_print ("Error: mmWave Start failed [mmWave Error: %d Subsys: %d]\n", mmWaveErrorCode, subsysErrorCode);
3709  /* datapath has already been moved to start state; so either we initiate a cleanup of start sequence or
3710  assert here and re-start from the beginning. For now, choosing the latter path */
3711  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
3712  return -1;
3713  }

3715  gMmwMssMCB.sensorStartCount++;

3743 void MmwDemo_stopSensor(void)
3744 {
3745  int32_t errCode;
3746 
3747  /* Stop sensor RF, data path will be stopped after RF stop is completed */
3748  MmwDemo_mmWaveCtrlStop();
3749 
3750  /* Wait until DPM_stop is completed */
3751  SemaphoreP_pend(&gMmwMssMCB.DPMstopSemHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
3752 
3753 #ifdef LVDS_STREAM
3754  /* Delete any active streaming session */
3755  if(gMmwMssMCB.lvdsStream.hwSessionHandle != NULL)
3756  {
3757  /* Evaluate need to deactivate h/w session:
3758  * One sub-frame case:
3759  * if h/w only enabled, deactivation never happened, hence need to deactivate
3760  * if h/w and s/w both enabled, then s/w would leave h/w activated when it is done
3761  * so need to deactivate
3762  * (only s/w enabled cannot be the case here because we are checking for non-null h/w session)
3763  * Multi sub-frame case:
3764  * Given stop, we must have re-configured the next sub-frame by now which is next of the
3765  * last sub-frame i.e we must have re-configured sub-frame 0. So if sub-frame 0 had
3766  * h/w enabled, then it is left in active state and need to deactivate. For all
3767  * other cases, h/w was already deactivated when done.
3768  */
3769  if ((gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.numSubFrames == 1) ||
3770  ((gMmwMssMCB.objDetCommonCfg.preStartCommonCfg.numSubFrames > 1) &&
3771  (gMmwMssMCB.subFrameCfg[0].lvdsStreamCfg.dataFmt != MMW_DEMO_LVDS_STREAM_CFG_DATAFMT_DISABLED))
3772  )
3773  {
3774  if (CBUFF_deactivateSession(gMmwMssMCB.lvdsStream.hwSessionHandle, &errCode) < 0)
3775  {
3776  test_print("CBUFF_deactivateSession failed with errorCode = %d\n", errCode);
3777  MmwDemo_debugAssert(0);
3778  }
3779  }
3780  MmwDemo_LVDSStreamDeleteHwSession();
3781  }
3782 
3783  /* Delete s/w session if it exists. S/w session never needs to be deactivated in stop because
3784  * it always (unconditionally) deactivates itself upon completion.
3785  */
3786  if(gMmwMssMCB.lvdsStream.swSessionHandle != NULL)
3787  {
3788  MmwDemo_LVDSStreamDeleteSwSession();
3789  }
3790 #endif
3791 
3792  /* Print epilog */
3793  MmwDemo_sensorStopEpilog();
3794 
3795  gMmwMssMCB.sensorStopCount++;
3796 
3797  /* print for user */
3798  test_print("Sensor has been stopped: startCount: %d stopCount %d\n",
3799  gMmwMssMCB.sensorStartCount,gMmwMssMCB.sensorStopCount);
3800 }

3866 static int32_t MmwDemo_calibInit(void)
3867 {
3868  int32_t retVal = 0;
3869  rlVersion_t verArgs;
3870 
3871  /* Initialize verArgs */
3872  memset((void *)&verArgs, 0, sizeof(rlVersion_t));
3873 
3874  /* Calibration save/restore init */
3875  gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.sizeOfCalibDataStorage = sizeof(MmwDemo_calibData);
3876  gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.calibDataHdr.magic = MMWDEMO_CALIB_STORE_MAGIC;
3877  memcpy((void *)& gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.calibDataHdr.linkVer, (void *)&verArgs.mmWaveLink, sizeof(rlSwVersionParam_t));
3878  memcpy((void *)& gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.calibDataHdr.radarSSVer, (void *)&verArgs.rf, sizeof(rlFwVersionParam_t));
3879 
3880  /* Check if Calibration data is over the Reserved storage */
3881  if(gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.sizeOfCalibDataStorage <= MMWDEMO_CALIB_FLASH_SIZE)
3882  {
3883  gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.calibDataHdr.hdrLen = sizeof(MmwDemo_calibDataHeader);
3884  gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.calibDataHdr.dataLen= sizeof(MmwDemo_calibData) - sizeof(MmwDemo_calibDataHeader);
3885 
3886  /* Resets calibration data */
3887  memset((void *)&gCalibDataStorage, 0, sizeof(MmwDemo_calibData));
3888 
3889  retVal = mmwDemo_flashInit();
3890  }
3891  else
3892  {
3893  test_print ("Error: Calibration data size is bigger than reserved size\n");
3894  retVal = -1;
3895  }
3896 
3897  return retVal;
3898 
3899 }

3914 static int32_t MmwDemo_calibSave(MmwDemo_calibDataHeader *ptrCalibDataHdr, MmwDemo_calibData *ptrCalibrationData)
3915 {
3916  uint32_t flashOffset;
3917  int32_t retVal = 0;
3918 
3919  /* Calculate the read size in bytes */
3920  flashOffset = gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.flashOffset;
3921 
3922  /* Copy header */
3923  memcpy((void *)&(ptrCalibrationData->calibDataHdr), ptrCalibDataHdr, sizeof(MmwDemo_calibDataHeader));
3924 
3925  /* Flash calibration data */
3926  retVal = mmwDemo_flashWrite(flashOffset, (uint8_t *)ptrCalibrationData, sizeof(MmwDemo_calibData));
3927  if(retVal < 0)
3928  {
3929  /* Flash Header failed */
3930  test_print ("Error: MmwDemo failed flashing calibration data with error[%d].\n", retVal);
3931  }
3932  return(retVal);
3933 }
3934 
3935 
3948 static int32_t MmwDemo_calibRestore(MmwDemo_calibData *ptrCalibData)
3949 {
3950  MmwDemo_calibDataHeader *pDataHdr;
3951  int32_t retVal = 0;
3952  uint32_t flashOffset;
3953 
3954  pDataHdr = &(ptrCalibData->calibDataHdr);
3955 
3956  /* Calculate the read size in bytes */
3957  flashOffset = gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.flashOffset;
3958 
3959  /* Read calibration data header */
3960  if(mmwDemo_flashRead(flashOffset, (uint8_t *)pDataHdr, sizeof(MmwDemo_calibData)) < 0)
3961  {
3962  /* Error: only one can be enable at at time */
3963  test_print ("Error: MmwDemo failed when reading calibration data from flash.\n");
3964  return -1;
3965  }
3966 
3967  /* Validate data header */
3968  if( (pDataHdr->magic != MMWDEMO_CALIB_STORE_MAGIC) ||
3969  (pDataHdr->hdrLen != gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.calibDataHdr.hdrLen) ||
3970  (pDataHdr->dataLen != gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.calibDataHdr.dataLen) )
3971  {
3972  /* Header validation failed */
3973  test_print ("Error: MmwDemo calibration data header validation failed.\n");
3974  retVal = -1;
3975  }
3976  /* Matching mmwLink version:
3977  In this demo, we would like to save/restore with the matching mmwLink and RF FW version.
3978  However, this logic can be changed to use data saved from previous mmwLink and FW releases,
3979  as long as the data format of the calibration data matches.
3980  */
3981  else if(memcmp((void *)&pDataHdr->linkVer, (void *)&gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.calibDataHdr.linkVer, sizeof(rlSwVersionParam_t)) != 0)
3982  {
3983  test_print ("Error: MmwDemo failed mmwLink version validation when restoring calibration data.\n");
3984  retVal = -1;
3985  }
3986  else if(memcmp((void *)&pDataHdr->radarSSVer, (void *)&gMmwMssMCB.calibCfg.calibDataHdr.radarSSVer, sizeof(rlFwVersionParam_t)) != 0)
3987  {
3988  test_print ("Error: MmwDemo failed RF FW version validation when restoring calibration data.\n");
3989  retVal = -1;
3990  }
3991  return(retVal);
3992 }

4038 static void MmwDemo_initTask(void* args)
4039 {

4053  MmwDemo_clearEccAggrs();

4057 
4058  MmwDemo_BoardInit();
4059 
4060  /* Debug Message: */
4061  test_print ("**********************************************\n");
4062  test_print ("Debug: Launching the MMW Demo on MSS\n");
4063  test_print ("**********************************************\n");
4064 
4065  /* Debug Message: */
4066  test_print("Debug: Launched the Initialization Task\n");
4067 
4068  /*****************************************************************************
4069  * Initialize the mmWave SDK components:
4070  *****************************************************************************/
4071 
4072  /* Initialize Last Frame data Set flag for first frame. */
4073  gMmwMssMCB.stats.isLastFrameDataProcessed = true;
4074 
4075 #ifdef LVDS_STREAM
4076  gMmwMssMCB.edmaHandle = gEdmaHandle[CONFIG_EDMA0];
4077 
4078  /* Initialize LVDS streaming components */
4079  if ((errCode = MmwDemo_LVDSStreamInit()) < 0 )

4081  test_print ("Error: MMWDemoDSS LVDS stream init failed with Error[%d]\n",errCode);
4082  return;
4083  }
4084 
4085  /* Configure Pad registers for LVDS. */
4086  HW_WR_REG32(CSL_MSS_TOPRCM_U_BASE + CSL_MSS_TOPRCM_LVDS_PAD_CTRL0 , 0x0);
4087  HW_WR_REG32(CSL_MSS_TOPRCM_U_BASE + CSL_MSS_TOPRCM_LVDS_PAD_CTRL1 , 0x02000000);
4088 
4089  /*The delay below is needed only if the DCA1000EVM is being used to capture the data traces.
4090  This is needed because the DCA1000EVM FPGA needs the delay to lock to the
4091  bit clock before they can start capturing the data correctly. */
4092  ClockP_usleep(12 * 1000);
4093 #endif
4094 
4095  /* initialize cq configs to invalid profile index to be able to detect
4096  * unconfigured state of these when monitors for them are enabled.
4097  */
4098  for(i = 0; i < RL_MAX_PROFILES_CNT; i++)
4099  {
4100  gMmwMssMCB.cqSatMonCfg[i].profileIndx = (RL_MAX_PROFILES_CNT + 1);
4101  gMmwMssMCB.cqSigImgMonCfg[i].profileIndx = (RL_MAX_PROFILES_CNT + 1);
4102  }
4103 
4104  /* Platform specific configuration */
4105  MmwDemo_platformInit(&gMmwMssMCB.cfg.platformCfg);
4106 
4107  /* Workaround for Errata ANA#46: Spurs caused due to data transfer activity */
4108  if (MmwDemo_registerChirpStartInterrupt() != 0)
4109  {
4110  CLI_write("Error: Failed to register chirp start interrupts\r\n");
4111  DebugP_assert(0);
4112  }
4113 
4114  /* Open the UART Instance */
4115  gMmwMssMCB.commandUartHandle = gUartHandle[CONFIG_UART0];
4116  if (gMmwMssMCB.commandUartHandle == NULL)
4117  {
4118  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
4119  return;
4120  }
4121 
4122  /* Open the Logging UART Instance: */
4123  gMmwMssMCB.loggingUartHandle = gUartHandle[CONFIG_UART1];
4124  if (gMmwMssMCB.loggingUartHandle == NULL)
4125  {
4126  test_print("Error: Unable to open the Logging UART Instance\n");
4127  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
4128  return;
4129  }
4130 
4131  DebugP_logInfo("Both UART instances opened");
4132 
4133  /* Create binary semaphores which is used to signal DPM_start/DPM_stop/DPM_ioctl is done
4134  * to the sensor management task. The signalling (SemaphoreP_post) will be done
4135  * from DPM registered report function (which will execute in the DPM execute task context). */
4136  SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&gMmwMssMCB.DPMstartSemHandle, 0);
4137  SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&gMmwMssMCB.DPMstopSemHandle, 0);
4138  SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&gMmwMssMCB.DPMioctlSemHandle, 0);
4139  SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&gMmwMssMCB.UartExportSemHandle, 0);
4140 
4141  /* Create binary semaphore to pend Main task, */
4142  SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&gMmwMssMCB.demoInitTaskCompleteSemHandle, 0);
4143 
4144  /*****************************************************************************
4145  * mmWave: Initialization of the high level module
4146  *****************************************************************************/
4147 
4148  /* Initialize the mmWave control init configuration */
4149  memset ((void*)&initCfg, 0 , sizeof(MMWave_InitCfg));
4150 
4151  /* Populate the init configuration: */
4152  initCfg.domain = MMWave_Domain_MSS;
4153  initCfg.eventFxn = MmwDemo_eventCallbackFxn;
4154  initCfg.linkCRCCfg.crcBaseAddr = (uint32_t) AddrTranslateP_getLocalAddr(CONFIG_CRC0_BASE_ADDR);
4155  initCfg.linkCRCCfg.useCRCDriver = 1U;
4156  initCfg.linkCRCCfg.crcChannel = CRC_CHANNEL_1;
4157  initCfg.cfgMode = MMWave_ConfigurationMode_FULL;
4158 
4159  /* Initialize and setup the mmWave Control module */
4160  gMmwMssMCB.ctrlHandle = MMWave_init (&initCfg, &errCode);
4161  if (gMmwMssMCB.ctrlHandle == NULL)
4162  {
4163  /* Error: Unable to initialize the mmWave control module */
4164  MMWave_decodeError (errCode, &errorLevel, &mmWaveErrorCode, &subsysErrorCode);
4165 
4166  /* Error: Unable to initialize the mmWave control module */
4167  test_print ("Error: mmWave Control Initialization failed [Error code %d]\n", errCode);
4168  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
4169  return;
4170  }
4171  test_print ("Debug: mmWave Control Initialization was successful\n");
4172 
4173  /* Synchronization: This will synchronize the execution of the control module
4174  * between the domains. This is a prerequiste and always needs to be invoked. */
4175  if (MMWave_sync(gMmwMssMCB.ctrlHandle, &errCode) < 0)
4176  {
4177  /* Error: Unable to synchronize the mmWave control module */
4178  test_print ("Error: mmWave Control Synchronization failed [Error code %d]\n", errCode);
4179  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
4180  return;
4181  }
4182  test_print ("Debug: mmWave Control Synchronization was successful\n");
4183 
4184  /*****************************************************************************
4185  * Launch the mmWave control execution task
4186  * - This should have a higher priroity than any other task which uses the
4187  * mmWave control API
4188  *****************************************************************************/
4189  gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.mmwCtrlTask = xTaskCreateStatic( MmwDemo_mmWaveCtrlTask,
4190  "mmwdemo_ctrl_task",
4191  MMWDEMO_MMWAVE_CTRL_TASK_STACK_SIZE,
4192  NULL,
4193  MMWDEMO_MMWAVE_CTRL_TASK_PRIORITY,
4194  gMmwCtrlTskStack,
4195  &gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.mmwCtrlTaskObj );
4196 
4197  configASSERT(gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.mmwCtrlTask != NULL);
4198 
4199 #ifdef ENET_STREAM
4200  /*****************************************************************************
4201  * Launch the mmWave enet task
4202  *****************************************************************************/
4203  /* Create Enet configuration done semaphore */
4204  SemaphoreP_constructBinary(&gMmwMssMCB.enetCfg.EnetCfgDoneSemHandle, 0);
4205 
4206  gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.enetTask = xTaskCreateStatic( enetTask,
4207  "enet_task",
4208  MMWDEMO_MMWAVE_ENET_TASK_STACK_SIZE,
4209  NULL,
4210  MMWDEMO_MMWAVE_ENET_TASK_PRIORITY,
4211  gMmwEnetTskStack,
4212  &gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.enetTaskObj );
4213 
4214  configASSERT(gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.enetTask != NULL);
4215 #endif
4216 
4217  /*****************************************************************************
4218  * Initialization of the DPM Module:
4219  *****************************************************************************/
4220  memset ((void *)&dpmInitCfg, 0, sizeof(DPM_InitCfg));
4221 
4222  /* Setup the configuration: */
4223  dpmInitCfg.ptrProcChainCfg = NULL;
4224  dpmInitCfg.instanceId = DPC_OBJDET_INSTANCEID;
4225  dpmInitCfg.domain = DPM_Domain_REMOTE;
4226  dpmInitCfg.reportFxn = MmwDemo_DPC_ObjectDetection_reportFxn;
4227  dpmInitCfg.arg = &objDetInitParams;
4228  dpmInitCfg.argSize = sizeof(DPC_ObjectDetection_InitParams);
4229 
4230  /* Initialize the DPM Module: */
4231  gMmwMssMCB.objDetDpmHandle = DPM_init (&dpmInitCfg, &errCode);
4232  if (gMmwMssMCB.objDetDpmHandle == NULL)
4233  {
4234  test_print ("Error: Unable to initialize the DPM Module [Error: %d]\n", errCode);
4235  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
4236  return;
4237  }
4238 
4239  /* Synchronization: This will synchronize the execution of the datapath module
4240  * between the domains. This is a prerequiste and always needs to be invoked. */
4241  while (1)
4242  {
4243  int32_t syncStatus;
4244 
4245  /* Get the synchronization status: */
4246  syncStatus = DPM_synch (gMmwMssMCB.objDetDpmHandle, &errCode);
4247  if (syncStatus < 0)
4248  {
4249  /* Error: Unable to synchronize the framework */
4250  test_print ("Error: DPM Synchronization failed [Error code %d]\n", errCode);
4251  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
4252  return;
4253  }
4254  if (syncStatus == 1)
4255  {
4256  /* Synchronization acheived: */
4257  break;
4258  }
4259  /* Sleep and poll again: */
4260  ClockP_usleep(1 * 1000U);
4261  }
4262 
4263  /* Launch the DPM Task */
4264  gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.mmwObjDetDpmTask = xTaskCreateStatic( mmwDemo_mssDPMTask,
4265  "mmwdemo_dpm_task",
4266  MMWDEMO_DPC_OBJDET_DPM_TASK_STACK_SIZE,
4267  NULL,
4268  MMWDEMO_DPC_OBJDET_DPM_TASK_PRIORITY,
4269  gDpmTskStack,
4270  &gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.mmwObjDetDpmTaskObj );
4271 
4272  configASSERT(gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.mmwObjDetDpmTask != NULL);
4273 
4274  /* Calibration save/restore initialization */
4275  if(MmwDemo_calibInit()<0)
4276  {
4277  test_print("Error: Calibration data initialization failed \n");
4278  MmwDemo_debugAssert (0);
4279  }
4280 
4281  /* Launch the UART Data Export Task */
4282  gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.uartDataExportTask = xTaskCreateStatic( mmwDemo_mssUartDataExportTask,
4283  "mmwdemo_uart_task",
4284  MMWDEMO_UART_DATA_EXPORT_TASK_STACK_SIZE,
4285  NULL,
4286  MMWDEMO_UART_EXPORT_TASK_PRIORITY,
4287  gUartTskStack,
4288  &gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.uartDataExportTaskObj );
4289 
4290  configASSERT(gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.uartDataExportTask != NULL);
4291 
4292  /*****************************************************************************
4293  * Initialize the Profiler
4294  *****************************************************************************/
4295  CycleCounterP_reset();
4296 
4297  /*****************************************************************************
4298  * Initialize the CLI Module:
4299  *****************************************************************************/
4300  MmwDemo_CLIInit(MMWDEMO_CLI_TASK_PRIORITY);
4301 
4302  /* Never return for this task. */
4303  SemaphoreP_pend(&gMmwMssMCB.demoInitTaskCompleteSemHandle, SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
4304 
4305  /* The following line should never be reached. */
4306  DebugP_assertNoLog(0);
4307 }

4332 static void MmwDemo_clearEccAggrs(void)
4333 {
4334  uint8_t idx = 0U;
4335 
4336  /* Clear all status registers of MSS ECC AGGR.*/
4337  for(idx = 0; idx <= MMWDEMO_MSS_ECC_AGG_RAM_IDS_TOTAL_ENTRIES; idx++)
4338  {
4339  /* Write the RAM ID in to Vector register*/
4340  CSL_REG32_FINS(MMWDEMO_MSS_ECC_AGG_MSS_ECC_VECTOR_ADDR, MSS_ECC_AGG_MSS_ECC_VECTOR_ECC_VECTOR, idx);
4341  /* Clear pending interrupts.*/
4342  CSL_REG32_WR(MMWDEMO_MSS_ECC_AGG_MSS_ERROR_STATUS1_ADDR, 0xF00);
4343 
4344  HW_WR_REG32((CSL_MSS_ECC_AGG_MSS_U_BASE + CSL_MSS_ECC_AGG_MSS_CONTROL), 0x7);
4345  ClockP_usleep(100);
4346  }

4366 static uint32_t computeSscFactCtrlVal(const uint32_t refClk, const uint16_t dpllM, MmwDemo_spreadSpectrumConfig *ptrdpllCfg)
4367 {
4368  float modRateSel = 0.0f;
4369  float deltaMStep = 0.0f;
4370  uint32_t delatMStepInt = 0U;
4371  float deltaMStepFrac = 0.0f;
4372  uint32_t deltaMStepFracInt = 0U;
4373  uint32_t modFreqDivExponent = 0U;
4374  uint32_t modFreqDivMantissa = 0U;
4375 
4376  modRateSel = (refClk * 1000.0f) / (4.0f * ptrdpllCfg->modRate);
4377 
4378  modFreqDivExponent = (uint32_t) (floor(modRateSel/MAX_MOD_FREQ_DIVIDER_MANTISSA));
4379 
4380  modFreqDivMantissa = (uint32_t) (floor(modRateSel / pow(2.0f, modFreqDivExponent)));
4381 
4382  ptrdpllCfg->modRate = refClk * 1000 / (4 * modFreqDivMantissa * (pow(2, modFreqDivExponent)));
4383 
4384  if(modFreqDivExponent <= 3U)
4385  {
4386  deltaMStep = (ptrdpllCfg->modDepth * dpllM) / (100.0f * modFreqDivMantissa * pow(2.0f, modFreqDivExponent));
4387  }
4388  else
4389  {
4390  deltaMStep = (ptrdpllCfg->modDepth * dpllM) / (100.0f * modFreqDivMantissa * 8.0f);
4391  }
4392 
4393  delatMStepInt = (uint32_t) (deltaMStep + 0.5f);
4394 
4395  deltaMStepFrac = deltaMStep - delatMStepInt;
4396 
4397  deltaMStepFracInt = (uint32_t) ceilf(deltaMStepFrac * (1U << 18U));
4398 
4399  ptrdpllCfg->modDepth = 100 * ( (deltaMStepFrac/ (1 << 18) ) * modFreqDivMantissa * ( 1U << modFreqDivExponent) / dpllM);
4400 
4401  return (deltaMStepFracInt + (delatMStepInt * (1U << 18U)) +
4402  (modFreqDivMantissa * (1U << 21U)) + (modFreqDivExponent * (1U << 28U)) +
4403  (ptrdpllCfg->downSpread * (1U << 31U)));
4404 }
4405 
4406 
4416 void MMWDemo_configSSC(void)
4417 {
4418  uint16_t dpllM = 0U;
4419  uint16_t dpllN = 0U;
4420  uint32_t finp = 40U; /* XTAL */
4421  uint32_t refClk = 0U;
4422 
4423  CSL_mss_toprcmRegs *ptrMssTopRcmRegs = (CSL_mss_toprcmRegs *)CSL_MSS_TOPRCM_U_BASE;
4424 
4425  if(gMmwMssMCB.coreAdpllSscCfg.isEnable)
4426  {
4427  dpllM = CSL_FEXT(ptrMssTopRcmRegs->PLL_CORE_MN2DIV,
4428  MSS_TOPRCM_PLL_CORE_MN2DIV_PLL_CORE_MN2DIV_M);
4429 
4430  dpllN = CSL_FEXT(ptrMssTopRcmRegs->PLL_CORE_M2NDIV,
4431  MSS_TOPRCM_PLL_CORE_M2NDIV_PLL_CORE_M2NDIV_N);
4432 
4436  refClk = finp/(dpllN + 1);
4437 
4438  ptrMssTopRcmRegs->PLL_CORE_FRACCTRL = computeSscFactCtrlVal(refClk, dpllM, &gMmwMssMCB.coreAdpllSscCfg);
4439 
4440  CSL_FINS(ptrMssTopRcmRegs->PLL_CORE_CLKCTRL, MSS_TOPRCM_PLL_CORE_CLKCTRL_PLL_CORE_CLKCTRL_ENSSC, 1U);
4441 
4442  }
4443 
4444  if(gMmwMssMCB.dspAdpllSscCfg.isEnable)
4445  {
4446  dpllM = CSL_FEXT(ptrMssTopRcmRegs->PLL_DSP_MN2DIV,
4447  MSS_TOPRCM_PLL_DSP_MN2DIV_PLL_DSP_MN2DIV_M);
4448 
4449  dpllN = CSL_FEXT(ptrMssTopRcmRegs->PLL_DSP_M2NDIV,
4450  MSS_TOPRCM_PLL_DSP_M2NDIV_PLL_DSP_M2NDIV_N);
4451 
4452  refClk = finp/(dpllN + 1);
4453 
4454  ptrMssTopRcmRegs->PLL_DSP_FRACCTRL = computeSscFactCtrlVal(refClk, dpllM, &gMmwMssMCB.dspAdpllSscCfg);
4455 
4456  CSL_FINS(ptrMssTopRcmRegs->PLL_DSP_CLKCTRL, MSS_TOPRCM_PLL_DSP_CLKCTRL_PLL_DSP_CLKCTRL_ENSSC, 1U);
4457 
4458  }
4459 
4460  if(gMmwMssMCB.perAdpllSscCfg.isEnable)
4461  {
4462  dpllM = CSL_FEXT(ptrMssTopRcmRegs->PLL_PER_MN2DIV,
4463  MSS_TOPRCM_PLL_PER_MN2DIV_PLL_PER_MN2DIV_M);
4464 
4465  dpllN = CSL_FEXT(ptrMssTopRcmRegs->PLL_PER_M2NDIV,
4466  MSS_TOPRCM_PLL_PER_M2NDIV_PLL_PER_M2NDIV_N);
4467 
4468  refClk = finp/(dpllN + 1);
4469 
4470  ptrMssTopRcmRegs->PLL_PER_FRACCTRL = computeSscFactCtrlVal(refClk, dpllM, &gMmwMssMCB.perAdpllSscCfg);
4471 
4472  CSL_FINS(ptrMssTopRcmRegs->PLL_PER_CLKCTRL, MSS_TOPRCM_PLL_PER_CLKCTRL_PLL_PER_CLKCTRL_ENSSC, 1U);
4473  }
4474 
4475  return;
4476 }

4486 int32_t main (void)
4487 {
4488  /* init SOC specific modules */
4489  System_init();
4490  Board_init();
4491 
4492  gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.initTask = xTaskCreateStatic( MmwDemo_initTask,
4493  "mmwdemo_init_task",
4494  MMWDEMO_INIT_TASK_STACK_SIZE,
4495  NULL,
4496  MMWDEMO_INIT_TASK_PRI,
4497  gAppMainTskStack,
4498  &gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.initTaskObj );
4499  configASSERT(gMmwMssMCB.taskHandles.initTask != NULL);
4500 
4501  /* Start the scheduler to start the tasks executing. */
4502  vTaskStartScheduler();
4503 
4504  /* The following line should never be reached because vTaskStartScheduler()
4505  will only return if there was not enough FreeRTOS heap memory available to
4506  create the Idle and (if configured) Timer tasks. Heap management, and
4507  techniques for trapping heap exhaustion, are described in the book text. */
4508  DebugP_assertNoLog(0);
4509 }
